# zkAGI

> zkAGI builds privacy-preserving AI infrastructure. Its public product is the
> Zynapse API at https://api.zkagi.ai/v1: an OpenAI-compatible gateway, also
> Anthropic-compatible on /v1/messages. It scrubs sensitive values before a
> model sees them, routes each call by privacy lane (fast = zero-data-retention
> open models, tee = open models in an attested GPU TEE, frontier = closed
> models, always scrubbed, opt-in), and returns a content-free receipt for
> every call.

Onboard an agent with these facts. They are exact as of 2026-11-07.

- Base URL (OpenAI SDKs): `https://api.zkagi.ai/v1`. Base URL (Anthropic SDKs, Claude Code `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`): `https://api.zkagi.ai`.
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer zyn_...` or `X-Api-Key: zyn_...`. A person makes keys at https://zkterminal.zkagi.ai/id/keys (the key is shown once) and adds credit at https://zkterminal.zkagi.ai/id/credit ($10 minimum to start; 402 without it). An agent cannot make a key; ask the human for one.
- Endpoints: `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `POST /v1/messages`. Public: `GET /v1/models`, `GET /v1/lanes`, `GET /v1/pricing`.
- Lane: model suffix `kimi-k3:tee`, or body `"lane": "tee"`, or header `X-Zynapse-Lane: tee`. The default for a key is `fast`. With no model, the call goes to `glm-5.3-flash`.
- fast models: deepseek-v4.1-flash, glm-5.3-flash, glm-5.3, kimi-k3. tee models: glm-5.3-flash, glm-5.3, kimi-k3, deepseek-v4-flash-0731, qwen3.8-27b, gemma-4-31b-it (tee only). Aliases: zynapse-fast, zynapse-balanced (both glm-5.3-flash), zynapse-max (kimi-k3).
- frontier (opt-in per account, 403 otherwise): claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5, claude-opus-5-5, claude-fable-5-1. A Claude id without `lane=frontier` is served by an open model.
- On fast and tee, an unrecognised model id is served by glm-5.3-flash (no error). Read the response `model` / `zynapse.served_by` to see what served the call.
- Tools (OpenAI and Anthropic formats) and streaming (SSE) work on every lane. Images and voice notes must be inline data URLs; video works on tee only. There is no image generation, embeddings or Responses API.
- Non-streaming responses include a `zynapse` object: lane, served_by, privacy_tier, sensitive_items_removed_before_send, receipt_url, cost_usd.

Full corpus in one file: https://docs.zkagi.ai/llms-full.txt

## Zynapse API

- [Quickstart](https://docs.zkagi.ai/docs/api/quickstart): get a key; curl, OpenAI Python/JS and Anthropic SDK examples
- [How it works](https://docs.zkagi.ai/docs/api/how-it-works): lanes, model choice, scrubbing and rehydration, the response block, headers, errors, receipts
- [Chat apps, agents and coding agents](https://docs.zkagi.ai/docs/api/integrations): LibreChat, Open WebUI, Claude Code, Hermes Agent, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, aider; tool calling and streaming
- [Images, voice, speech and documents](https://docs.zkagi.ai/docs/api/multimodal): image/video input, voice notes, /v1/audio/transcriptions, /v1/audio/speech, /v1/files/extract
- [Endpoint reference](https://docs.zkagi.ai/docs/api/zynapse): every public route

## Trust and status

- [Status board](https://docs.zkagi.ai/docs/trust-center/status): what is live and what is R&D
- [Security model](https://docs.zkagi.ai/docs/trust-center/security-model): threat model
- [Disclosures](https://docs.zkagi.ai/docs/trust-center/disclosures): the fine print
- [Receipts](https://docs.zkagi.ai/docs/platform/receipts): the per-call compliance record
